notes: The plan is not in plans-v1.json; it is listed in aux_plans with its render and scale bar so that the checking tool can find it. Site located from the published coordinates (23 deg 14' 15" N, 70 deg 40' 39" E, Gadekar et al. 2014) and the 2008 contour plan's description of the mound south-west of NH-8A: the published point falls in a 210 m Prosopis stand between the highway (north-east), a north-south road (east) and a dry channel (west), which we take as Valmiyo Timbo. Zoom 19 holds only placeholder tiles here, so the current zoom-18 mosaic (Vantor Vivid, 2026-03-20, 0.34 m source resolution) is used. All points are class C on a vegetation edge taken as the mound foot; the west and south edges of the stand are sharp and straight, while its north-west, north and east sides are bounded by a field, a track and road-side trees, which is why cp1, cp4 and cp5 carry 15-20 m confidence notes. Orientation statements seen while reading context (none used for points): IAR 1987-88 p. 15 describes a 'north-south running floor like structure' in trench A of the Gujarat State excavation; IAR 1989-90 p. 20 says structures in trenches G and H were 'mainly oriented north-south'. Agent S also measured this plan's fortification (measure-S/towns/shikarpur.json) before registering it, as the search brief requires.
